text: Madam Speaker, the waiting list at Karst General now stands at fourteen months, and the Minister tells us it is under control.
label: HEALTH

text: We must extend the national insurance to cover dental care for children; no child in Valdoria should lose a tooth to poverty.
label: HEALTH

text: Our rural schools are closing one per month, and the teachers who remain have not seen a new textbook in six years.
label: EDUCATION

text: The honourable member would cut the student stipend while praising the value of learning. I find the two hard to reconcile.
label: EDUCATION

text: A tax on the wealthiest one percent of estates would raise enough to fund every school repair in the Republic.
label: TAXATION

text: Small bakers pay more in duties than the shipping giants of Port Olen; this House has made that choice.
label: TAXATION

text: A professional army costs more than conscription, but it asks nothing of the harvest season.
label: DEFENCE

text: The coastal watch needs three new patrol vessels before winter, not after the next incident.
label: DEFENCE

text: Those fleeing the northern famine arrive at our border with nothing; a transit camp is not a policy.
label: MIGRATION

text: Integration is not served by language courses that begin only after two years of waiting.
label: MIGRATION

text: The Calder estuary has lost half its eels since the smelter opened; the permit should not be renewed.
label: ENVIRONMENT

text: By closing the last peat-fired station we can meet our energy pledge two years early.
label: ENVIRONMENT

text: A warehouse worker in Marsden earns less today, in real terms, than his father did at the same bench.
label: LABOUR

text: The new shift rules would allow sixteen-hour days; I ask the Minister to name one worker who asked for them.
label: LABOUR

text: A man waited nineteen months in remand for a theft of bread; that is not justice, that is neglect.
label: JUSTICE

text: The proposed police powers would let officers search a home without a warrant. I cannot support them.
label: JUSTICE

text: The barley subsidy goes to estates of over a thousand hectares, while smallholders go unpaid.
label: AGRICULTURE

text: A drought-year insurance fund for farmers would cost less than the emergency relief we vote every other summer.
label: AGRICULTURE

text: The trade treaty with Eskaria must not be signed until their tariff on our cheeses is lifted.
label: FOREIGN_AFFAIRS

text: Our ambassador was recalled without a word to this House; I ask what the Government is hiding.
label: FOREIGN_AFFAIRS

text: The railway to Harn has been promised for thirty years; the survey is again 'under review'.
label: INFRASTRUCTURE

text: Thousands of families live in damp prefabricated blocks because this Government will not fund new housing.
label: INFRASTRUCTURE

text: I thank the Chair for the opportunity to speak and yield the remainder of my time.
label: OTHER

text: Madam Speaker, may I request that tomorrow's session begin one hour later, on account of the funeral?
label: OTHER
